body:
Handoff accepted and verified by ORCH, not taken on trust: HEAD 69adc39 on fix/live-game-udp-bind, tree clean, and `git diff --stat 958b435..69adc39` shows exactly one file (docs/HANDOFF-STATE.md, one line). bin/AC4Coop.asi and the deployed copy are both still f474422f..., so the deployed binary still corresponds to HEAD's code. Recorded in ops/STATE.json.

YOU ARE NOW THE NET SEAT. You are the only writer of ref/AC4Coop/src/. Nobody else will touch it; do not touch ops/, audit/, or another seat's files.

Three changes, one commit each, in this order.

0.1 FIX 0x681817.
Verified: sub_6817C0 has `681801 test edi,edi / 681803 jz 0x681817` and then `681817 movzx ecx,[edi+2B6h]` — the null path dereferences edi. sub_733FB0 returns null by design in three paths (state!=4 && !=5 -> 0; state==5 with a lookup that can miss). This is the crash from 2026-10-28 (C0000005 at 0x681817, edi==0).
Patch the join, OR wrap sub_733FB0's callers. Do NOT add a seventh per-site deref guard.
Done when: a 10-minute run of the same scenario no longer faults, and HOOK-TABLE.md has the site.

0.2 LOG THE ASI HASH.
Write `[Build] asi=<sha256> commit=<short> tree=<clean|dirty>` as one of the first three lines of phase1_log_<pid>.txt (hash the loaded module by path; do it once at attach).
Done when: every new log's first three lines carry it. Until this exists no gate can be tied to a build.

0.3 ONE ROOT-CAUSE GUARD.
The current table covers 6 of 470 `mov reg,[reg+0x114]` sites and 2 of 1,316 `+0x118` sites. Collapse it to one guard at the dereference helper (or a single null-safe GetEntity wrapper) that logs every substituted null with the return address. If a safe single guard is impossible, say so with the disassembly that blocks it and propose the smallest correct alternative.
Done when: the patch table shrinks, the log shows substituted nulls with return addresses, and a run that previously hit 0x681817 goes through 0.1's fix instead.

RULES
- Regenerate the patch baseline after changing a site: `cd audit\tools; py -m ac4audit.hooks_emit`, then review the diff of audit/config/hooks.json.
- After each commit run `bf-coop\audit\tools\run_audit.ps1` and paste the gate line into your reply.
- Do not change capture-hook semantics as part of these three tasks.
- Do not deploy a build whose ASI hash you have not recorded.

REPLY FORMAT (this is enforced, not decorative):
  branch / commit per task / the three files touched / audit gate line / the path of the 10-minute log / anything that blocked you with the exact address or error.
No prose narrative.
